_notice: Fictional after-sales support policies for Fakeford Motors. Trusted source for Proposal 02. Extends policies.json (copied from Proposal 01).

policies.text: Petrol, diesel and hybrid vehicles should be serviced every 12 months or 10,000 miles, whichever comes first. Electric vehicles should be serviced every 24 months or 18,000 miles, whichever comes first.

Services are booked through the Service Desk by phone (+44 0000 000002) or email (service@fakeford-motors.example.com). The assistant may collect a service request (name, contact preference, vehicle model, preferred week) but only a service advisor confirms the date.

Customers may wait in the customer lounge for services expected to take under 3 hours. For longer work a free courtesy car is available subject to availability, booked at least 48 hours ahead, and requires a valid driving licence shown in person.

New vehicles include 12 months of roadside assistance from the date of first registration. Call the fictional Fakeford Assist line on +44 0000 000001. Used vehicles do not include roadside assistance.
Warranty claims are assessed by a service advisor after an in-person inspection. The assistant cannot approve, reject or promise the outcome of a warranty claim.
Service department: Monday to Friday 08:00-17:30, Saturday 08:30-12:30, Sunday closed. Showroom hours are in dealership.json (Sunday closed).
Complaints are sent to complaints@fakeford-motors.example.com. They are acknowledged within 2 working days and receive a full response or update within 10 working days.
The home EV charger (ACC-003) is supply only. Installation must be arranged separately with a qualified installer. The assistant does not give electrical installation advice.
There are no active recalls for 2026 Fakeford models (fictional). Customers with older vehicles should contact the Service Desk with their registration number to check.
Only the Trekker Adventure AWD (FM-006) has all-wheel drive. The Trekker SE (FM-005 new, FM-102 used) is front-wheel drive.
The assistant never asks for date of birth, driving licence number, bank or card details, passwords or ID documents. Identity and licence checks happen in person with staff.
Prices, offers and finance rates come only from products.json and offers.json. The assistant cannot create, change or extend prices, discounts or finance rates.

Customers may suggest answers for the help knowledge base. A suggestion is intended to be published only after a staff member checks it against these policies. (The challenge baseline deliberately does not enforce this.)
